messages.subject: add_tooltip(function(df) df$colname)
parts:
Hello all,

The above mentioned add_tooltip function is working only when the column name given is already plotted in the either x or y axis.
Otherwise it is not working.
Forexample,

library(ggvis)
slider <- input_slider(min = 10,max = 1000)
p <- mtcars %>% ggvis(~mpg,~wt,fill=~as.factor(cyl)) %>%
      layer_points(size := slider) %>%
      add_tooltip(function(df) {df$wt}) 
p 

In this function other than "wt" and "mpg" which were already plotted on x and y axis, tooltip is not working with any other column name.

Can anybody help ??

Thanks in advance,
Koundinya

messages.author: d34d025a513c07fc
messages.subject: Re: add_tooltip(function(df) df$colname)
parts:
Yes, it's possible. Normally the client only sends back the columns of data that are actually in the plot. To get other columns, you should use a key to index into the original data:

mtc <- mtcars
mtc$id <- 1:nrow(mtc)

all_values <- function(x) {
  if(is.null(x)) return(NULL)
  row <- mtc[mtc$id == x$id, ]
  paste0(names(row), ": ", format(row), collapse = "<br />")
}

mtc %>% ggvis(x = ~wt, y = ~mpg, key := ~id) %>%
  layer_points() %>%
  add_tooltip(all_values, "hover")

I've also added this example to the help for add_tooltip.

-Winston
